text: Swimming is an active sport that requires athletes to move in a coordinated way, using their lungs and muscles to propel themselves through the water. Breathing first is essential, as the body needs oxygen to sustain the activity. When swimming, the body uses the lungs to extract oxygen from the air and convert it into a usable form for the body's cells. Kicking later is another important element, as it allows the athlete to propel themselves forward while using the leg muscles to push off the water.
